steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: These organisations are motivated by Jesus' teaching to care for the poor and the parable of the Good Samaritan. They work regardless of the religion of the people they help — reflecting Christian love for all people, not just Christians. | RS Exam Tips — The Worldwide Church: 1. For The Worldwide Church questions, always include specific scriptural or source references where relevant 2. Explain both religious and non-religious viewpoints 3. Use specialist vocabulary precisely (e.g. terms from the specification) 4. Evaluate by analysing strengths and weaknesses of different views before reaching your conclusion 5. Link your discussion of The Worldwide Church to its real-world impact on believers and society

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Explain two ways the worldwide Church works for reconciliation. | "Christian aid organisations should only help Christians." Evaluate this statement.

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on RS Exam Tips — The Worldwide Church, and one past-paper question.
